item.title: Apex Files: Honey Badger Wars Part 4 — "What They Try Instead"
item.description:
Scar the honey badger has survived leopards, hyenas, and a 12-strong wild dog pack — so Africa's predators are adapting. In Part 4 of the Apex Files: Honey Badger Wars series, we break down the shift from direct confrontation to siege tactics: waiting out the burrow, targeting the exits, and testing the one weakness even a honey badger's loose skin and toxin resistance can't fix — time.
This episode picks up directly from the lion coalition roar and unresolved wild dog den thread from Part 3, and sets up the next confrontation in the Africa's Hierarchy series.
🦡 Previous episodes: Part 1 — Honey Badger vs. African Rock Python - [https://youtu.be/yhsRfb55kUE] Part 2 — Honey Badger vs. Baboon Troop vs. Leopard - [https://youtu.be/V1y4MR49lN8] Part 3 — Honey Badger vs. Black Mamba -[https://youtu.be/0si7isRzNAY]
